briefdescription.para: Ends a parse job on the message thread, and keeps its document when the row still matches.

detaileddescription.para: The result is kept only when the row at rowIndex still has the path, and the file still has the modification time that the job read. A result that does not match is dropped with no message. For a match, a document replaces the stored document of the path, and no document erases it. A failed validation sets the overlay message. When the last pending job ends, the count of documents is written.

briefdescription.para: Parses the source files of the model on a pool thread, and keeps the parsed documents.

detaileddescription.para: Each file row of the model starts one parse job. No ValueTree reaches the pool thread. A job returns its result to the message thread, and the result is kept only when the row still holds the same path and the file still has the modification time that the job read. The documents are keyed by the index of their path in paths.

The processor also answers the request rows of the model. Each request row runs the entry of events that its command names. The entry writes JSON to the result of the row. The lookups read the documents in place and keep nothing.
